reproduction.notes: Fully deterministic: exact sympy rationals plus a 40-digit mpmath ODE cross-check. No external data download, no GPU, no network access required at run time (the arXiv sources were read once during authorship and their equations are transcribed into the script and the .md).

verification: Re-run and diff the JSON. The script asserts its own O(u_i^2) ODE residual is exactly 0.
